issues.description: The Person entity's id field type is inconsistent across artifacts: the template declares the id as Long, the solution's Person class declares the id field as Integer while its getId()/setId() methods use Long, and the repository interfaces use Long as the entity id generic. This mismatch will cause compilation errors and confusion (repository expects Long but the entity field is Integer and accessors mismatch).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the id type consistent across the project. Recommended: change the solution's Person.id declaration to Long (matching the template and repository) and ensure the getId()/setId() methods use Long. Alternatively, if Integer is desired, update repository generics and all accessors to Integer consistently.
